module: Flowgraph node "Cycle Pool" (once_instant). Swaps an active vehicle and an inactive vehicle of the pool to keep the same number of running vehicles (pool:cycle). Input pins: vehPool, vehId1 (active, optional), vehId2 (inactive, optional); outputs: inactiveId, activeId. Requires the core_vehicleActivePooling module; the pool object comes from the Create Vehicle Pool node.
notes: Bug: workOnce reads self.pinIn.activeId and self.pinIn.inactiveId, which do not exist (the input pins are named vehId1 and vehId2; activeId/inactiveId are outputs): the call raises a Lua error and the outputs are never written.

workOnce.desc: Meant to call pool:cycle(activeId, inactiveId); see the note about the incorrect pin names.
